state:
**Goal `php-oracle-retired`: Stage 5 (no mechanical migration is planned) is complete on disk; Stage 6 (no list maps PHP to Novis) is next.** ADR 0274 (`docs/decisions/0274.md`) is the goal's record.

On disk: M11's plan file and record, the eight `tooling/convert-*` rules and the two converter `php-migration/` rules are deleted. No live rule fragment, page, spec, reference chapter or Rust/`.nvst` comment names `nvs convert` or M11: `rule:programs/no-compatibility-promise` now says a program is ported by rethinking it, by hand or with an agent and `nvs agent` (its `because` gains 0274). ADR 0089 is `retired` (YAML block and `data/decisions/0089.json`, summary dropped) per 0274 § 4, so `docs/decisions.md` no longer describes the converter. `docs/novis.md` is regenerated. 0111 stays `accepted` until Stage 6 removes its last rule.

`docs/spec/02-php-migration.md` and `data/spec/php-migration.json` only lost their converter sentences; Stage 6 deletes both.

next.title: no list maps PHP to Novis, file set 1 (the compiler and the editor)
next.note: one file set: the PHP-name table, its build join, E0320's PHP clause and the LSP's PHP-name completion layer. Goal prose § *Stage 6*, item 1.

items.text: **The PHP-name table and its build join are deleted** — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/php_names.rs:1`, its join in `crates/nvs-stdlib/build.rs:12`, and `tools/data/php-builtins.txt` (`rule:php-migration/the-php-name-layer-is-joined-at-build-time`, deleted in file set 3).

**E0320 always gives its general help** — `nvs_hir::PhpFunctions` at `crates/nvs-hir/src/members.rs:192` and its argument leave `resolve_program_linted` and the two callers `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1948` and `crates/nvs-lsp/src/document.rs:681`; the acceptance test `an_undefined_free_function_gets_the_general_help` in nvs-hir is written. A frozen case that prints the PHP clause is rewritten in the same commit, named in its message.

**The PHP-name completion layer leaves the LSP** — `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs:176` (`php_builtins`, `php_item`, module doc), `PhpNames` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/settings.rs`, the server's two reads, `nvs.completion.phpNames` in `editors/vscode/package.json` and its test, and the PHP-name tests in `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion.rs` (`rule:php-migration/every-php-builtin-is-a-completion-candidate`).

backlog: Stage 6 file set 2: the list's data, `tools/nv/cmd/migration.ts`, the `Replaces` column and its readers, the tests and gates that hold the list — goal prose § *Stage 6* item 2.
Stage 6 file set 3: the five PHP-name rules, `website/src/content/claims/php-migration-is-accounted.md`, the list's playbook entries; ADR 0111 turns `retired` in that commit (0274 § 4).
